name: smwgraphics-super-mario-maker-super-mario-world-underwater
title: Super Mario Maker: Super Mario World - Underwater
description:
The underwater tileset from Super Mario Maker's Super Mario World style. Can be combined with any other default SMW tileset.

Uses up palette slots used by the berries and works best with the cave tileset.
